scenes.title: 2023 Max Planck 8-Week Pudding Trial: Flat Bathroom Scale vs Rewired fMRI Reward Surge
scenes.era: 2023, Max Planck Institute for Metabolism Research, Cologne, Germany

layout.description: Crisp sunlit clinical nutrition & fMRI suite pairing two matched pudding cups (High-Fat/High-Sugar vs Calorie-Matched Low-Fat), an unchanged digital floor scale, and an illuminated 8-Week Striatal fMRI Reward Lightbox.

positions.who: 45-year-old normal-weight adult volunteer in smart casual sweater and slacks
positions.where: seated at the tasting table pushing aside a plain low-fat bowl and reaching eagerly for the rich sweet-fatty pudding cup beside a flat weight scale
positions.facing: facing the two tasting bowls and fMRI display

positions.who: Sharmili Edwin Thanarajah in crisp white clinical coat holding Week-8 fMRI scan chart
positions.where: standing beside the fMRI lightbox pointing to the surging nucleus accumbens and striatal dopamine response despite zero weight gain
positions.facing: observing the tasting table and lightbox

props.name: paired Week-8 pudding cup and untouched low-fat whole-food bowl
props.period_detail: stages Thanarajah et al.'s 2023 8-week daily pudding intervention and post-trial preference shift
props.physical_behavior: State-A hand hovers between low-fat berry yogurt bowl and glossy sweet-fatty pudding cup -> State-B pushes healthy bowl away and scoops the sweet-fatty cup

props.name: unchanged floor weight scale beside glowing Striatal fMRI Reward Lightbox
props.period_detail: captures the study's central shock: zero weight change vs steep brain-reward rewiring
props.physical_behavior: State-A digital scale needle stays locked flat at baseline -> State-B fMRI reward meter lights bright across ventral striatum

actions.verb_sequence: steps off the unchanged floor scale smiling -> sits at the Week-8 tasting tray -> pushes the plain low-fat option aside and reaches straight for the sweet-fatty snack
illuminates the Week-8 fMRI scan revealing amplified dopaminergic reward firing

reactions.reaction: blinks in disbelief seeing their brain rewired while body weight stayed identical
points out that brain plasticity precedes weight gain

scenes.wardrobe: Navy knit crewneck over collared shirt and tailored trousers; researcher in white clinical coat.
scenes.recognition_hook: Eight weeks of one small daily sugary-fatty snack changed zero pounds on the scale — yet quietly rewired the brain's reward center to reject simpler, healthier food!

key_visual.description: a sunlit Max Planck nutrition lab where a normal-weight adult pushes a healthy bowl aside for a sweet-fatty pudding cup beside an unchanged floor scale and a glowing striatal fMRI lightbox

scenes.title: 9 P.M. Kitchen Pantry Habit Cue: Why Fat + Sugar Fools Ancient Brain Wiring

layout.description: Warm evening kitchen island contrasting natural single-fuel foods (almonds = fat; crisp apple = carb) against an ultra-processed frosted snack bar combining both.

positions.where: opening pantry door at 9 p.m. and comparing a foil-wrapped pastry bar against whole almonds and an apple

props.name: wooden bowl of whole almonds and red apples beside foil-wrapped ultra-processed snack bar
props.period_detail: illustrates DiFeliceantonio et al. (2018) fat-only / carb-only vs fat+carb combo
props.physical_behavior: State-A sets foil snack bar back into cupboard -> State-B picks up crisp red apple and handful of roasted almonds

actions.verb_sequence: pauses at pantry door -> closes wrapper drawer -> plates sliced apple and roasted almonds

reactions.reaction: nods understanding why artificial fat+sugar combos hijack reward math

scenes.recognition_hook: Nature rarely mixes high fat and high sugar in one bite — which is why ultra-processed combos double-hit your reward circuit.

scenes.title: Outdoor Weekend Farmers' Market Stroll: Re-Sensitizing the Adult Palate
scenes.era: Modern sunlit Saturday morning outdoor farmers' market (Outdoor)

layout.description: Vibrant open-air morning farmers' market under canvas canopies where a 50-year-old couple tastes fresh ripe berries and roasted walnuts in crisp sunshine.

positions.where: standing at an outdoor wooden produce stall tasting a fresh strawberry and placing whole produce into a canvas tote

props.name: pint of ripe strawberries, walnuts, and woven canvas market bag
props.physical_behavior: State-A lifts ripe berry from wooden crate -> State-B places fresh berries into canvas tote

actions.verb_sequence: samples fresh seasonal fruit -> packs whole foods for the week's afternoon snack slot

reactions.reaction: savors bright natural sweetness once daily ultra-processed snacks step out of the way

scenes.wardrobe: Sand linen overshirt, white tee, dark jeans.
scenes.recognition_hook: Step away from daily fat-plus-sugar snacks for a few weeks and whole foods taste vivid again.
